decision: Selected the centroid of City and County of Denver parcel 0234531031000 in the State of Colorado public parcel composite (situs 1500 CHAMPA ST; owner of record M R CHAMPA LLC; legal description EAST DENVER B130 L5 TO 16; land use COMMERCIAL-OFFICE). DEN3 occupies space in this multi-tenant building, so the point locates the host building's parcel, not DataBank's suite.

address_points.suite_points: the statewide address layer returns 13 further 1500 Champa St points for suites (B100, 100, 200-205 and 306-310), all within 44 m of the building point; the Denver records carry no parcel number, so the link is point-in-parcel

computed.method: Esri rings converted to shapely 2.1.1 polygons; union and planar centroid in WGS84 longitude/latitude (an Albers equal-area centroid agrees to 1e-7 degrees); areas geodesic on WGS84 (pyproj 3.7.1 Geod); extent in UTM zone 13N (EPSG:32613).
computed.coordinate_reference_system: WGS84 longitude/latitude: the statewide composite layer is stored in EPSG:4326 and was queried with outSR=4326; no transformation.
